about: The take/give modes the native take_give (src/events/event_exec.c, original 2C94C) implements. Every other mode in 0..255 returns TAKE_GIVE_UNSUPPORTED at the dispatch stop (take 2C9FF, give 2CFD9). Each entry names the original handler from the dispatch tables (take CS:23D5 by mode - 8, modes 8..6Bh, else 2CFC9; give CS:22F1 by mode - 3, modes 3..6Bh, else 2DC50; CS = 2B98h). Checked by tools/coverage/world_exceptions.py check (each handler against the XEEN.DAT image) and by CTest phase228_take_give_contract (the implementation behaviour, every mode 0..255 in each role). Update this file in the same change that adds or removes a mode.

0.what: nothing taken (the take table starts at mode 8; 2CFC9 skips to the give)

20.what: a map flag bit of F01F cleared (side x 256 + value)

21.what: an item: the first matching row removed by 43385/43428, or a quest-item counter F025 decremented; none: REFUSED

34.what: party gold (F00A) minus the value; too little: SHORT

35.what: party gems (F00E) minus the value; too little: SHORT

103.what: a game flag bit of F05F cleared

104.what: a map flag bit of F06F cleared (side x 30 + value)
